items.headline: Woman, 36, jailed 13 years for filming Megan Khung's abuse and helping dispose of the body
items.summary: Nouvelle Chua Ruoshi was sentenced on 13 November to 13 years' jail for her role in the death of four-year-old Megan Khung, including filming the abuse and helping dispose of the body.

items.headline: Eight teens aged 12 to 15 arrested over a late-night prank at a Hougang flat
items.summary: Police arrested eight boys over repeated late-night knocking on a Hougang Avenue 8 unit on 12 November; all are being investigated for public nuisance after the prank was publicised online.

items.headline: Woman jailed 16 weeks after 71 cats were left in a Bukit Panjang flat, nine of them dead
items.summary: A 33-year-old woman was sentenced to 16 weeks' jail after pleading guilty to 24 charges over 71 cats kept without adequate food or water in a Bukit Panjang flat, during which nine cats died.

items.headline: Brazilian superfan rallies a 500-strong crowd for a Brazil-Japan watch party at The Kallang
items.summary: A Brazilian fan living in Singapore is gathering a 500-strong crowd to watch the Brazil versus Japan international at The Kallang on 14 November.

items.headline: India cancels a Norwegian journalist's visa hours before a Hyderabad summit
items.summary: Norwegian journalist Helle Lyng says India's Home Ministry cancelled her visa minutes before she was due to fly to the Congress-organised Bharat Summit in Hyderabad, where she was invited to speak on press freedom; she links it to a question she put to PM Modi in Oslo in May.

items.headline: Update: Europe wins a seat at Ukraine peace talks as Putin digs in on peacekeepers
items.summary: After Witkoff and Kushner met Putin in Moscow on 12 November, Russia signalled it could let Europe into future negotiations; Putin reiterated opposition to any foreign peacekeeping force in Ukraine, and the envoys travelled on to brief Zelenskyy.

items.headline: Iran and the US stay locked in a 'no war, no peace' standoff
items.summary: Iran's chief negotiator says Tehran has sent a seven-condition proposal through Qatari mediators to secure a ceasefire and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, including sanctions relief and an end to a US naval blockade; analysts call the stalemate fragile.

items.headline: Trump says 'no deal necessary' with Iran as divisions surface in his team
items.summary: President Trump said no deal was necessary with Iran even as Tehran floated ceasefire terms, with Al Jazeera reporting that his approach has sidelined Vice-President JD Vance and exposed divisions within the administration.

items.headline: Winter storms flood Gaza's tent camps as shelter runs short
items.summary: Heavy rain has flooded tens of thousands of displaced families' tents across Gaza, with Gaza's Government Media Office reporting about 70,000 inundated in 12 hours; civil defence reported a mother and three children died when a rain-soaked embankment collapsed in Deir al-Balah.

items.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, letting AI agents shop and check out
items.summary: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, letting its agents make purchases with per-transaction approval, built with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa; agents never see the real card number, with the rollout limited at first to some US ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18 and over.

items.headline: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress after resigning from Nvidia
items.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang agreed to testify before US lawmakers after threats of a subpoena, following his 12 November resignation amid affair allegations and a suspected Chinese-intelligence link; Senate Banking Chair Tim Scott sought a 3 December appearance, and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick also agreed to testify.

items.headline: Wall Street slips on Friday but still posts a winning week as Nvidia's slide deepens
items.summary: US stocks fell on 13 November, with the S&P 500 down about 0.4% to 7,561.67 and the Nasdaq off roughly 0.9%, while the Dow edged up 0.1%; all three gained for the week. Nvidia logged a sixth straight weekly decline after Jensen Huang's resignation.

items.headline: US 10-year Treasury yield climbs above 5% as bets on another Fed hike firm
items.summary: The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield pushed above 5% on 13 November as traders leaned toward a further Federal Reserve rate increase, after October producer prices rose 0.3% month on month; the backdrop pressured equities and left gold near a one-week low.

items.headline: Pegula saves a match point to beat Noskova and set up a semifinal with Andreeva
items.summary: Jessica Pegula saved a match point to edge Linda Noskova 7-6(2), 4-6, 7-5 at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells, booking a semifinal against Mirra Andreeva, who had topped her group by beating Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 6-0.

items.headline: New Zealand thrash India by 244 runs to cut the ODI series to 2-1
items.summary: Matt Henry took a career-best 6-27 as New Zealand bowled India out for 89 to win the fourth ODI at Bay Oval by 244 runs, trimming India's series lead to 2-1; Will Young made a century off 88 balls in New Zealand's 333.

items.headline: Update: Pakistan and Sri Lanka draw the first Test in Rawalpindi
items.summary: The first Test between Pakistan and Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi ended in a draw, with the sides shaking hands early in the final session; Sri Lanka had replied with 446 to Pakistan's first-innings 434 for 9 declared.

items.headline: Update: Hamilton closes to within a point of Russell in F1's fight for second
items.summary: Ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix on 19-21 November, Lewis Hamilton has climbed to within a single point of George Russell in the battle for second in the drivers' championship, with Max Verstappen leading that race by 17 points; Antonelli and Mercedes have already clinched both titles.

items.headline: More than a quarter of cactus species risk losing most of their range to drought
items.summary: A Nature study modelling 993 cactus species finds severe drought and warming could leave more than 25% of them losing at least 80% of their suitable climate area by 2100, with the sharpest losses in Chile, Peru, and north-eastern Brazil.

items.headline: Scientists map 26 million cells to build the most detailed brain basal-ganglia atlas yet
items.summary: An international team profiled nearly 26 million cells from the basal ganglia across humans and other primates, releasing a multi-species cellular atlas of a region tied to Parkinson's, Huntington's, schizophrenia, and addiction, published across the Cell Press journals.

items.headline: Real-world data show RSV vaccines sharply cutting infant hospitalisations
items.summary: Nature reports RSV vaccines and monoclonal antibodies are producing steep drops in hospitalisations, with Denmark's national maternal-vaccination programme linked to a marked fall in infant admissions; a Lancet meta-analysis estimated maternal vaccination cut admissions in babies under six months by about 74%.

fun_fact.headline: The Moon drifts about 3.8 cm farther from Earth each year
fun_fact.body: The Moon is drifting away from Earth by about 3.8 centimetres a year; measured since 1969 via Apollo laser reflectors, the retreat also gradually lengthens Earth's day.

puzzle.title: Through the Looking Glass
puzzle.body: You catch sight of a wall clock in a bathroom mirror. In the reflection, the hands clearly read 3:45. What time is it really?
puzzle.approach: Picture the clock face flipped left-to-right, then work out where the hands really point.
puzzle.answer: 8:15. A mirror flips the clock left to right, so a real time T shows up as (11:60 minus T): 11:60 - 3:45 = 8:15.

word_puzzle.title: Deep End
word_puzzle.body: Centre letter O; outer letters D H I L N P. Find the pangram (an aquatic mammal) and 12+ words of four letters or longer.
word_puzzle.approach: Build words that all include the centre letter O; the seven letters spell an aquatic mammal.
word_puzzle.answer: Pangram: DOLPHIN. Others: HOLD, LION, LOIN, LOON, POOL, POND, PLOD, PLOP, IDOL, LIDO, OPINION, DIPLOID.
